Release v4.4.14 (#975)

Updating Apex public repo to version 4.4.14

Co-authored-by: github-actions <apex@macrocosmos.ai>

Merge fix/provider-diagnostics-windows-console into main

Windows console and synchronous pipe handles now receive provider diagnostics through a bounded queue drained by one writer thread; a full queue drops and counts records, and Close cancels a blocked write with CancelSynchronousIo before joining. Tested on Windows 11 arm64 (diagnostics suite, 19 tests x3). macOS anonymous pipes and sockets are still refused, so this resolves the reported Windows case only.

Refs https://github.com/urfoundation/sn/issues/8

feat(scoring): conversions on small campaigns can be scored as a count (switch, off)

From SN21_COUNT_SCORE_FROM, a result with no conversion percentage because
fewer than 3 conversions were expected is scored on the count: the miner's
count is expected x (1 + their conversions p50), compared with no change by
Poisson deviance (score = D(no change) / (D(miner) + D(no change)), 0.5 = as
good as no change). It is blended in as the result's conversion part, weighed
like cost. The same score pooled per miner per day is added to the accuracy
feed beside the standing, not counted in it.

A new slug avoids the retired qwen state row, so the next boss round trains chunk 0 from the seed instead of the old winner.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

Cap HTTP/2 upstream streams per connection and prepare 0.5.3-dev (#331)

* Cap HTTP/2 upstream streams per connection and add keepalive

Every HTTP/2 upstream cluster used default http2_protocol_options, so a
worker multiplexed all its streams to a provider over one connection with
no PINGs. A connection cut on the network path failed every in-flight
stream at once, and the route retry cannot help after headers.

Set max_concurrent_streams: 32 and connection_keepalive (30s interval,
10s timeout) on all twelve HTTP/2 upstream clusters. Envoy opens more
connections as each fills, so total concurrency is unchanged.

* Prepare 0.5.3-dev

Deliver diagnostics to Windows consoles and pipes

A Windows provider run in a console still wrote nothing: console and pipe
handles were refused because their synchronous writes cannot honor a
context. A dedicated writer thread now owns a duplicated console or
synchronous-pipe handle behind a bounded queue. The exporter's write only
enqueues, so it never waits on the device; a full queue drops and counts.
Close drains for one write budget, then cancels the writer's in-flight
write with CancelSynchronousIo and joins it before closing the duplicate.
Overlapped pipes stay refused.

Tests: portable queue tests (order, never waits, overflow counted, Close
interrupts and joins a blocked write) and Windows tests on a real console
screen buffer, a pipe, and an unread pipe whose blocked write Close cancels.

Deliver diagnostics to Windows consoles and pipes

A Windows provider run in a console still wrote nothing: console and pipe
handles were refused because their synchronous writes cannot honor a
context. A dedicated writer thread now owns a duplicated console or
synchronous-pipe handle behind a bounded queue. The exporter's write only
enqueues, so it never waits on the device; a full queue drops and counts.
Close drains for one write budget, then cancels the writer's in-flight
write with CancelSynchronousIo and joins it before closing the duplicate.
Overlapped pipes stay refused.

Tests: portable queue tests (order, never waits, overflow counted, Close
interrupts and joins a blocked write) and Windows tests on a real console
screen buffer, a pipe, and an unread pipe whose blocked write Close cancels.

Fixes https://github.com/urfoundation/sn/issues/8

10s timeout) on all twelve HTTP/2 upstream clusters. Envoy opens more
connections as each fills, so total concurrency is unchanged.
